scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/web && node copy-static.js
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w apps/web && npm run lint -w apps/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/web && npm run typecheck -w apps/api
scripts.test: npm run test -w apps/web && npm run test -w apps/api
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage -w apps/web && npm run test:coverage -w apps/api
